value.name: crew films Dicky smoking crack
value.description: An HBO crew records Dicky high in a filthy crack house kitchen while he smokes crack and talks to camera.
evidence: HBO crew filming Dicky smoking crack, Bic lighter in his hand, leaning against half of an old dining-room table in a filthy kitchen
DICKY (mumbling fast to camera, high out of his mind)

value.name: Dicky blames others for missed opportunity
value.description: While high, Dicky complains that his crew and family failed to understand the opportunity he had before fighting Sugar Ray.
evidence: They didn't understand. They're practically my gang, they usually listen to me but didn't understand the opportunity
Before you fought Sugar Ray -- DICKY Oh, yeah, all the money I coulda made if we just fuckin' did it RIGHT, they threw me in too early.

value.name: Dicky regrets being rushed into Sugar Ray fight
value.description: Dicky says he was put in against Sugar Ray too early and believes he needed a slower buildup to succeed.
evidence: they threw me in too early. We didn't know, my mothah didn't know, Sugar Ray was too much, too soon. I needed to build slow.

value.name: Dicky compares himself to Micky
value.description: Dicky imagines that if he had Micky's discipline combined with his own talent, he would have been unstoppable.
evidence: If I had Micky's discipline, with my talent, forget about it.

value.name: Dicky mentions family pride
value.description: Dicky brings up his wife Debbie and daughter Kerry, saying he wants Kerry to be proud of him.
evidence: My wife Debbie was the prettiest girl in Lowell, and my daughtah Kasie, I mean Kerry, I want Kerry to be proud a me.

value.name: Karen questions the filming
value.description: Karen asks why Dicky is allowing the crew to film him smoking crack and what the movie is about.
evidence: KAREN Why you let them film you smokin'? What this movie about again?

value.name: HBO producer explains crack documentary
value.description: The producer explains that the film is about crack addiction and its real effects so kids can see what it does.
evidence: HBO PRODUCER I told you it's about crack addiction. Showing what can happen, what it really is, so kids can see it for real.

value.name: BooBoo starts explaining crack
value.description: BooBoo begins to explain how crack works in the brain, interrupting the producer's explanation.
evidence: BOOBOO I can tell ya about the way it works in the brain--

value.name: Dicky asserts control of the film
value.description: Dicky cuts BooBoo off, insists the movie is still his, and says the crack scene will make his and Micky's comeback more dramatic.
evidence: DICKY Excuse me, BooBoo, it's still my movie, and this part [lights pipe] will make me and Micky's comeback more dramatic.

value.name: Dicky smokes more crack
value.description: Dicky inhales from the pipe again as he prepares to explain crack's effects.
evidence: I'll tell ya how crack works [inhales from pipe].
